text: Hey team, Acme Corp (been with us 4 years) is asking for a refund for last month's invoice due to the billing mixup. It's been 45 days since that charge, I know SOP says 30 days max.
For loyal customers over 2 years tenure, we can bypass the 30-day rule. Go ahead and approve the refund for Acme Corp.
We have an active platform outage affecting all EU servers. Customers are opening tickets left and right.
Do not try to troubleshoot individual EU tickets right now. Just send the incident response template and close the tickets.
